maria: Morning — nightly evals alert: promptset_long_context QA fail rate jumped 0.5% -> 12% on redwood-3b-int4-packedkvv2. failing gens show token echo/repeat when context > ~2048. anyone already looking?
kevin: on it, grabbing the failing logs and reproductions.
deploy-bot: Deploy redwood-3b-int4-packedkvv2 -> prod completed (rev: a1b2c3d) at 2026-03-20T01:10Z
chao: i saw a tiny repro in smoke yesterday but chalked it up to noisy evals. can you paste an example?
maria: here is one failing generation that the nightly eval flagged:
```
PROMPT: "Given the following document, answer succinctly... [long context ~6k tokens]"
GEN: "The answer is that the policy should be to reduce cost. The answer is that the policy should be to reduce cost. The answer is that the policy..."
```
kevin: i can repro locally with the prod rev when seq_len >= 4096 and packed_kv enabled. behavior: repeated chunks of phrase, looks like stale KV being reused across steps.
eva: hypothesis: packed-kv int4 kernel misaligns nibble offsets at block boundaries -> reads stale cache entries. maybe an off-by-one when shifting during unpack.
chao: any recent changes to packed-kv code or quant packing logic?
kevin: PR merged last night altered the int4 pack order to improve throughput (PR #4189). blame shows change in packed_kv_v2.cu that touched the byte-shift loop.
sam: ops/ps: recommend immediate rollback and gating for packedkvv2 on int4. oncall?
oncall-bot: paging eng-oncall: nightly-eval regression exceeded threshold (12%).
sam: initiating rollback to previous stable model (redwood-3b-v2-int4-baseline rev z9y8x7) and disabling packedkvv2 flag in runtime config for prod.
deploy-bot: Rollback to rev z9y8x7 initiated by sam at 2765432130
kevin: repro/debug notes I ran:
```bash
# reproduce script (local)
python tools/run_eval.py --model rev:a1b2c3d --promptset promptset_long_context --seq-len 4096 --packed-kv v2
# observed repeated token sequences after step ~10240 tokens
```
kevin: root cause (current hypothesis): when int4 data is packed into nibbles, the unpack routine uses a byte boundary calc that fails on sequences crossing a 128-byte block boundary. that causes the KV read pointer to be off by 1 nibble and return the previous chunk. repeated reads of the stale chunk produce the echo.
eva: proposed mitigations: 1) rollback (done), 2) disable packedkvv2 for int4 until fix, 3) add strict unit test for nibble alignment and a fuzz test that crosses block boundaries, 4) add nightly eval check that fails if we detect >=5 token repeat runs in generations, 5) canary pipeline with promptset_long_context + long run to exercise boundary.
maria: actions and owners:
- Sam: confirm rollback complete and open ops ticket (OPS-989) — assigned
- Kevin: PR with zero-init and bounds-check for packed-kv unpack code + unit tests (in review) — PR #4214
- Eva: add gating rule to canary: must pass promptset_long_context >=99.5% for two consecutive runs before auto-promote — ticket ML-3123
- Chao: add nightly-eval token-repeat detector and alert rule (>=2% delta) — assigned
- Maria: draft postmortem template and coordinate post-rollback monitoring
deploy-bot: Rollback to rev z9y8x7 completed at 2765432130
kevin: submitted PR #4214 with zero-init + extra bounds checks; added unit test that explicitly reproduces nibble misalign on block boundary. marking as high-priority.
eva: gating rule added to canary config; canary now runs promptset_long_context nightly with stress multiplier x2.
chao: added a quick eval script to run against candidate builds: runs 3x promptset_long_context with seq_len sweep and flags packed_kv disabled/enabled — pushed to infra repo.
sam: created OPS-989 and ML-3123, linked to PR #4214 and included rollback timeline. scheduled hotfix canary deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT.
maria: monitoring update: nightly eval fail rate back down to 0.6% after rollback. keeping canary disabled for auto-promote until PR lands and passes. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident 2765432101 marked mitigated (rollback)
maria: follow-ups: postmortem writeup due EOD tomorrow, include perf delta report (packedkvv2 vs baseline), add checklist for model bring-up that includes long-context promptset and nibble-alignment unit tests.
kevin: i'll push tests to CI and follow up on perf tradeoffs (packedkvv2 gave ~12% token throughput improvement in ideal case, need to quantify regression risk).
maria: great work team — we'll reconvene after hotfix canary run. :shipit:
